content:
Ava: heads up — invoice preview shows +1.2M token credit for tenant acme-corp, production ledger shows 0. I *think* this started after today's enrich-deploy.
Priya: which pipeline? ingest or tally?
Ava: streaming-ingest -> route-enrich -> tally. The enrichment service emits `enriched_event` and tally listens. We see gaps in the enriched_event topic (kafka) during 10:32-10:36.
Mateo: deploy-bot started canary for enrich @10:31, any errors?
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for service=enrich v=2.7.3 at 2025-11-05T10:31:12Z
Ben: pile logs pls
Ava: pasted small snippet:
```
ERROR tally.consumer - commit failed: OffsetOutOfRange
offset 125432 > highwater 125400
```
Ben: ack, sounds like consumer fell behind and then reprocessed? Could cause double-counts or misses depending on idempotency
Priya: tally uses idempotent keys built from request_id + model_version. If enriched_event missing the request_id we drop it downstream.
Ava: enrichment rollout had a change that renamed `reqId` -> `request_id` in payload
Mateo: ohhhh
Lily: so some events had `reqId` and others `request_id`. Tally's mapper expects `request_id` exclusively
Ben: any counts showing duplicates vs missing? dashboard?
Ava: invoice-preview shows extra credits (dup) for some tenants and missing credits for others. Cross-checking sample IDs shows mismatch depending on which pod produced event
Priya: propose hotfix: mapper fallback to `reqId` if `request_id` missing + backfill on compacted topic
Mateo: also need to patch enrichment canary rollback to stable until fix
Ava: action items: (1) rollback canary (2) release mapper-fallback patch (3) run a reconciliation job to rehydrate missing events from logs and compacted topic
Ben: +1. who's owned?
Ava: I'll rollback, Priya will open PR for mapper, Mateo will run reconciler with dry-run first
Lily: add console dashboard alerts for schema changes — small schema-drift detector
Priya: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/enrich/+/2345
Mateo: reconciler dry-run started — sample 1k tenants, will produce diff CSV at s3://redwood-recon/2345.csv
Ava: rollback done, canary stopped at 10:45
deploy-bot: canary stopped for service=enrich at 2025-11-05T10:45:06Z
Ben: will follow up on invoice preview after recon completes
Lily: thanks team :tada:
Ava: filing postmortem and will add schema-compat test to CI
